title: Inverse Source Problem for a Time-Fractional Diffusion-Wave Equation with a Singular Inverse-Square Potential
summary: This paper investigates an inverse source problem for a time-fractional diffusion-wave equation with a singular inverse-square potential. The source term is assumed to consist of a known temporal factor and an unknown spatial component, which is to be recovered from terminal-state measurements. The well-posedness and regularity of the forward problem are established within an appropriate energy framework by exploiting Hardy-type inequalities and the spectral properties of the associated singular elliptic operator.
